Commentary.Commentary: We are back for Pakistan's reply! Mohammad Rizwan and Babar Azam walk in with their blades. Dilshan Madushanka to start with the ball. Here we go.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then, this should be an exciting contest and Pakistan will be hoping to put on a good show with the bat now. The Lankans will look to grab some early wickets and defend the total. This game surely promises to be a cracker. Do join us for the run chase shortly.

Naseem Shah is up for a quick chat. He says that they got an amazing start with the Powerplay, but towards the end, they gave away 20 runs extra. Adds that there was some swing and seam early on, but later on it got better for batting and he hopes his batters will bat well.

Pakistan were off to a flying start and they had got half of the Sri Lankan side back into the hut inside the first 10 overs. They struggled a bit after that but did manage to get Hasranga in the 15th over. They would be a bit upset with their fielding as the man in form, Rajapaksa was dropped twice in the game. Haris Rauf bowled an amazing spell of 4-0-29-3. Pakistan will be hoping for their batters now to chase this down and win the cup.

What a finish this has been for Sri Lanka! Who would have thought they would get to the 170-mark? But Bhanuka Rajapaksa's explosive innings has powered them to a stong total. After they lost half their side in a heap,  it was the likes of Bhanuka Rajapaksa and Wanindu Hasaranga who took off well after the 10th over and stitched a partnership of 58 from 36 balls and some repair work. Bhanuka Rajapaksa in particular was the man for the Lankans who scored an amazing 71 from 45 deliveries and made the Lankans reach a total of 170. They would be looking to defend it now.
SIX! BANG! Bhanuka Rajapaksa finishes the innings off in style! Outside off, a fuller ball. Bhanuka Rajapaksa smashes this one over deep cover for a flat six. Sri Lanka ends with 170 for 6!
FOUR! Cheeky! A fuller ball, around middle. Bhanuka Rajapaksa shuffles across and scoops it gently over short fine leg for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! Lovely ball! Slower short ball, outside off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa hops and tries to cut this one away but he fails to get any connection on that.
Full on this occasion, around middle. Bhanuka Rajapaksa whips this one towards deep square leg for a brace. The 160 is up for Sri Lanka!

Shorter one, another slower ball, around middle and leg. Bhanuka Rajapaksa gets a top edge while trying to pull this one. The ball goes towards the fielder at deep square leg who collects the ball on a bounce. Two taken.
Slower ball at 105 clicks, a shorter one, around middle. Chamika Karunaratne miscues his pull shot towards deep square leg for a single.
Slight halt in play! Shadab is down and is looking in some pain. He has injured his head. Pakistani physio is looking on him. Naseem Shah to bowl the final over.

SIX! Collison and the catch has been dropped, once again! A length ball, around middle. Bhanuka Rajapaksa hoicks this one towards deep mid-wicket. Asif Ali there goes for the catch, Shadab Khan from deep square leg, runs to his left for the catch as well. Shadab Khan dives to grab that one, but he collides with Asif Ali and the ball hits their hand and goes over the ropes for a biggie. Another life for Bhanuka Rajapaksa.
Another play and a miss! On a length, around middle and off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa shuffles across and tries to scoop this one away but he misses.
Swing and a miss! Outside off, short again, pace on this time, Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to pull this one but he misses.
Short and outside off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa taps it towards point.
Slower one, another short ball, around middle. Chamika Karunaratne gets an inside edge onto his thigh pad while going for the pull shot. The balls goes towards square leg for a single.
Outside off, shorter one again. Bhanuka Rajapaksa taps it towards cover and takes a single.

A short ball, outside off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa guides it down to third man takes a single. That nrings up the 50 for Bhanuka Rajapaksa! What a crucial knock this has been in the context of the game. He will want to stay till the last ball and take Sri Lanka to a better total.
Pitches this one up again, around middle and off. Chamika Karunaratne taps it towards cover for a single.

IN THE AIR... AND PUT DOWN! A tough change though. A fuller one, slower as well, around middle. Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to heave this one away but the ball goes off the outer of the bat and flies high, into the night sky towards long off. Shadab Khan runs for the ball, settles under it, but fails to hold on to that one. Three taken.
Tight single! Fuller ball, outside off. Chamika Karunaratne pushes it towards cover and scampers across to the other end.

FOUR LEG BYES! A slower one, darting this one around the leg pole, a length ball. Chamika Karunaratne walks across and looks to flick this one away. But he misses the ball brushes off his pads and goes away from the fielder at short fine leg towards the boundary for four runs.
Back of a length, outside off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa hangs back and cuts it towards the fielder at third man. A single taken.

SIX! KABOOM! Another maximum of the over and it's Chamika Karunaratne this time. A fuller ball, around middle and off. Chamika Karunaratne dispatches this one over long on for a biggie. Good over this for Sri Lanka, 16 runs off it.
Pitches this one up, around off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa shimmies down the wicket and drives it over cover. Only a single.
SIX! Oh, shot! A fullish ball, around the leg pole. Bhanuka Rajapaksa whips this over fine leg for a biggie.
Another length ball, darting this one on the pads. Chamika Karunaratne tucks it towards square leg for a single.

Bye! Too short on this occasion, slower one as well, outside off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to upper cut this one but he misses. Mohammad Rizwan fails to collect the ball cleanly and the batters cross ends!
Leg bye! This one angles in, a length ball, around middle and leg. Chamika Karunaratne misses his flick, the ball hits hit thigh pad and goes towards point. A leg bye taken.
Naseem Shah comes into the attack.
Quicker at 105 clicks, outside off, very full on this occasion. Chamika Karunaratne pushes it through cover and ends the over with a single.
A loopy ball, full and on middle and off. Chamika Karunaratne prods forward and blocks it out.
Tosses this one up, servers it full again, around off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa dances down the pitch and drills it down the ground. Only a single.
Outside off, fuller ball. Chamika Karunaratne strokes this one down to long off and takes a single.
Pitches it up, around middle, fuller ball. Chamika Karunaratne leans forward and defends it out.
A fuller ball, angling in, around middle and leg. Chamika Karunaratne sweeps this one towards short fine leg.
Mohammad Nawaz comes into the attack for the first time in this game.
Yorker and down the leg side, Chamika Karunaratne digs it to mid on for one.
Chamika Karunaratne comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHINS! Touch fuller and outside off, Wanindu Hasaranga makes room and looks to loft it but gets a slight outside edge. The ball goes towards Mohammad Rizwan who makes a loud appeal and the finger goes up. Pakistan finally breaks this partnership and Wanindu Hasaranga walks out for 36. He has played a vital knock for his side.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Wanindu Hasaranga. Fuller and on off, Wanindu Hasaranga plays it over the diving fielder at point and towards the fence. Boundary!
FOUR! On a length and on off, slower too. Wanindu Hasaranga lofts it over mid off for a boundary. Wanindu Hasaranga is playing an excellent knock here!
Slightly shorter again, Wanindu Hasaranga slaps it to covers for a brace. Good running!
Slightly shorter, around middle and leg, Wanindu Hasaranga defends it towards short covers.
Bowls it down the leg side, Wanindu Hasaranga looks to flick it but he misses. The ball hits his pads and rolls away towards point. They cross for a leg bye.
Another dot as this is played towards the fielder at point.
Fuller and on off, Wanindu Hasaranga cuts it but finds the fielder at point.

Fuller and outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa eases it to short third man and calls for a quick single. The fielder makes a throw towards the keeper who gathers the ball and knocks the stumps. Wanindu Hasaranga dives in to make his ground. The replay shows that the batter was well in. Good running!
FOUR! Fuller and on off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa dances down the track and lofts it down the ground for a boundary!
Tossed up on leg, Wanindu Hasaranga shuffles across and eases it to long off for one.
Yorker and on off, Wanindu Hasaranga digs it to point for one.
SIX! Shorter and outside off, Wanindu Hasaranga uses the pace of the ball and helps it over backward point for a maximum. First six of the innings!
Fuller again, Wanindu Hasaranga lofts it to deep extra cover. The fielder does well at the boundary line. They collect a couple of runs.
FOUR! Fuller one, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga shuffles across and drives it past covers for a boundary.
Yorker and outside off, Wanindu Hasaranga digs it to point and straight to the fielder.
Back of a length and on off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa guides it to third man for one.
Mohammad Hasnain comes back into the attack. He has gone for 19 runs in his two overs so far.
Slightly shorter one this time, Bhanuka Rajapaksa punches it towards the off side for one.
FOUR! This one lands fuller as well. Bhanuka Rajapaksa uses the pace of the ball and guides it to third man for a boundary!
Fuller one this time, Wanindu Hasaranga slog sweeps it to mid-wicket for one.
Slightly shorter and on off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa punches it to mid off for one.
Tossed up on middle, Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to sweep it but gets a top edge onto his pads. The ball rolls back towards the bowler.
Goes fuller and on off, Wanindu Hasaranga works it to mid-wicket for one.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to cut it but misses. 10 off the over.
Bowls it down the middle, Wanindu Hasaranga blocks it away solidly.
FOUR! Slightly shorter and outside off, Wanindu Hasaranga hangs back and slaps it past point for a boundary. Good timing on the stot from Wanindu Hasaranga.
Tossed up, around off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! This one lands fuller and on off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa uses his feet and lofts it over covers for a boundary. Excellent shot!
Slightly shorter and outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to play at it but misses.

Drinks! Pakistan are off to a dream start in the finals. They have got half of the Sri Lankan side back into the hut inside 10 overs. Sri Lanka will be hoping Bhanuka Rajapaksa and Wanindu Hasaranga put on a strong partnership and take their side to a competitive total.

Back of a length, spinning in, around middle. Wanindu Hasaranga pushes it towards mid-wicket and he sets off for a single. Bhanuka Rajapaksa at the other end is watching the ball and sends back Wanindu Hasaranga mid-way. At the halfway mark, Sri Lanka are 67 for 5!
Tap and run! Outside off, fuller one. Bhanuka Rajapaksa leans forward and dabs it towards cover for a quick single.
Quicker, straighter, short as well. Bhanuka Rajapaksa stays in his crease and pushes it to the right of the bowler.
Outside off, back of a length. Bhanuka Rajapaksa slashes this one past backward point for brace.
Full, quicker this time, around middle. Wanindu Hasaranga eases this one towards long on and takes a single.
Outside off, shorter in length, spinning away. Bhanuka Rajapaksa dabs it towards point and takes a run.

FOUR! Wanindu Hasaranga gets off the mark in style! A googly now, shorter ball, around middle and off. Wanindu Hasaranga rocks back, opens the face of the bat and guides it past short third man for a boundary.
Wanindu Hasaranga walks in.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! Shadab Khan strikes and gets rid of the Sri Lankan skipper, Dasun Shanaka now! Well bowled once again. A loopy ball, slower through the air, full and straight this time. Dasun Shanaka looks to heave this one across the line over mid-wicket but he misses. The ball goes onto knock the stumps. Sri Lanka have lost half their side now.
Very full, flighted delivery, around off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa knocks it towards long off for a single.
Another tossed-up delivery, around the leg pole, fuller in length. Bhanuka Rajapaksa gets down on his knee and looks to sweep this one but he misses. A stifled appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no.
Loopy ball, a full toss, around middle. Dasun Shanaka sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
A googly, quicker, and shorter, outside off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa hangs back and dabs it towards third man and takes a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa taps it towards point and ends the over with a single. A successful over from Iftikhar Ahmed!
Fuller ball, drifting in, around middle and leg. Dasun Shanaka knocks it towards mid-wicket and takes a run.
Dasun Shanaka is the next batter.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Another one bites the dust! Iftikhar Ahmed sends back the set batter, Dhananjaya de Silva to the hut now. Pakistan continues to grab wickets at regular intervals and Sri Lanka are in a spot of bother now. Iftikhar Ahmed pitches this one slightly short, around middle, slower through the air. Dhananjaya de Silva rocks back and looks to go downtown, but he ends up chipping back to the bowler. Iftikhar Ahmed takes a good return catch near his head.
Another full ball, outside off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa lunges forward and steers it down to third man for a single.

FOUR! Edgy runs but Bhanuka Rajapaksa will not mind that. A loopy ball, this one lands around off and spins away. Bhanuka Rajapaksa leans forward and tries to block this one with soft hands. But the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a boundary. That brings up the 50 for Sri Lanka!
Iftikhar Ahmed begins with a short ball, spinning in, around middle. Dhananjaya de Silva uses the depth of his crease and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Iftikhar Ahmed comes to bowl.
Very full, loopy one, around middle and off. Dhananjaya de Silva stokes it down to long off for a single.
Short now, outside off, spinning away. Dhananjaya de Silva cuts it towards the fielder at cover-point.
Tosses this one up, full and around off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa knocks it towards long off and rotates the strike.
Three singles in a row now! This is the wrong'un, short in length, outside off. Dhananjaya de Silva lifts this over cover for a single.
Another back-of-a-length delivery, a leg-break this time, on the pads. Bhanuka Rajapaksa tucks it towards square leg and takes another run.
Shadab Khan begins with a shorter ball, outside off. Dhananjaya de Silva rocks back and pushes it towards sweeper cover for a single.
End of Powerplay! Shadab Khan comes into the attack now.
An overpitched delivery, outside off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa opens the face of the bat and guides it towards deep point for a brace. Sri Lanka are 42 for 3 at the end of the Powerplay!

Another peach from Haris Rauf! Fuller ball, nipping in again, around the leg pole. Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to flick but he misses and gets pinged on his pads. A huge appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no! Babar Azam opts for a review. No bat involved there confirms UltraEdge. The Ball Tracking indicates that was clipping the leg stump, but it is the umpire's call on wickets hitting. Bhanuka Rajapaksa survives. Sri Lanka will want him to stick around!
Another length ball, nipping back in, around middle. Bhanuka Rajapaksa pushes it back to the bowler. This is terrific bowling from Haris Rauf!
Well bowled once again! A fuller one, swinging in, around middle. Bhanuka Rajapaksa does well block this one out.

FOUR! Bhanuka Rajapaksa gets off the mark with a streaky boundary! On a length, outside off, this one shapes away. Bhanuka Rajapaksa leans forward and looks to block this one. But the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a boundary.
Bhanuka Rajapaksa walks in.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! What a peach of a delivery! Two wickets in two overs for Haris Rauf and Pakistan are bossing the game so far! Haris Rauf speeds in from over the wicket, and he serves a length ball, this one jags back in after pitching, around middle and at around 151 clicks. Danushka Gunathilaka looks to drive this one but he gets beaten on the inside edge. The ball goes on and shatters the stumps Sri Lanka have lost their third now!
On a length and on off, Danushka Gunathilaka taps it to covers. The fielder has a needless shy at the non-striker's end. An overthrow allows the batters to steal a single.
This one lands outside off, Danushka Gunathilaka eases it towards the fielder at point.
On a length around off, Dhananjaya de Silva flicks it to square leg for one.
FOUR! Length ball on off, Dhananjaya de Silva punches it over covers for a boundary. Excellent shot.
Good length and on leg, Danushka Gunathilaka looks to play at it but the ball hits his pads and goes towards square leg. They cross for a leg bye.
Slightly shorter and on middle, Dhananjaya de Silva eases it to mid on and scampers for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the non striker's end but misses.
Change of ends for Mohammad Hasnain!
On a length and on middle, Dhananjaya de Silva works it to mid wicket for one.
FOUR! Touch fuller, outside off. Dhananjaya de Silva drives it past covers for a boundary. Excellent timing!
On a length and on off, Dhananjaya de Silva taps it towards the fielder at point. Dot.
An outswinger outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva looks to drive it but misses. That was close.
Danushka Gunathilaka is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Pakistan have got the big fish and it is Haris Rauf who gets them their second wicket in his first over. This is fuller and on off, Pathum Nissanka looks to loft it over mid off but mistimes it completely. The ball goes off the bottom of the bat and flies up in the air. Babar Azam runs behind from mid off and takes an excellent catch. Pathum Nissanka walks out for 8.
Commentary.Howout: c Babar Azam b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: Good length on off, this is defended off the front foot.
Haris Rauf is introduced into the attack.
Fuller and outside off, Pathum Nissanka guides it to third man for one.
Good length and outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva taps it towards deep point for one.
On a length, around off. Pathum Nissanka looks to play at it but gets an inside edge towards the left of the keeper. Close!
FOUR! Sublime. Slightly shorter and on off, Pathum Nissanka punches it through covers for a boundary!
On a length and on leg, Pathum Nissanka looks to flick it but misses as the ball hits his pads. A loud shout but the finger stays down. The replay shows that the ball was drifting down the leg side.
This one lands outside off, fuller in length, Pathum Nissanka looks to drive it but misses. Close!
Bowls it on a good length, Dhananjaya de Silva flicks it towards backward square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Good shot. Fuller and on off, Dhananjaya de Silva lofts it over extra cover for a boundary.
Wide! On a length and just outside leg, Dhananjaya de Silva looks to flick it but misses. A stifled appeal but the umpire is uninterested. The replay shows that the ball had brushed his thigh pad.
Slightly shorter, around off. Dhananjaya de Silva looks to play at it but gets a botton edge towards the keeper.
FOUR! Bowls a fuller one this time at 145 clicks, Dhananjaya de Silva creams it past covers for a boundary. Excellent timing!
Another one on off, Pathum Nissanka looks to tap it but gets a bottom edge towards short third man. They take a quick single.
Mohammad Hasnain bowls a length ball on off, Pathum Nissanka eases it towards the off side.
Who will bowl from the other end? Mohammad Hasnain it is!
This one lands on middle, Dhananjaya de Silva flicks it to deep square leg for a brace. A good over to start with for Pakistan!
Good length and around middle, Dhananjaya de Silva covers his line and blocks it away.
On a length outside off, this one nips back in as well. Dhananjaya de Silva leaves it alone.
Dhananjaya de Silva walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! A RIPPER! Perfect start for Pakistan. Naseem Shah is right on the money. This one lands just outside off and nips in a long way at 142 clicks. Kusal Mendis looks to block it but gets beaten on the inside edge and the ball goes onto shatter the stumps. Kusal Mendis walks out for a golden duck and Pakistan have an early breakthrough in the game!
Fuller one this time, on off, Pathum Nissanka looks to drive it but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg. They cross.
Length ball again, on middle and leg, Pathum Nissanka gently flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket. Dot.
Wide! Starts with a length ball wide outside leg, Pathum Nissanka leaves it alone. Mohammad Rizwan does well to collect it diving to his left. Wided.

We are done with the pre-match formalities and now it's time for action to get underway one last time in the Asia Cup 2022. The players of Pakistan are seen in a huddle before they take their field positions. Kusal Mendis and Pathum Nissanka will be the openers for Sri Lanka. Naseem Shah will begin with the ball. Let's go!
The stage is set for the final! The players of both teams make their way out for the national anthems. It will be Pakistan's first, followed by that of Sri Lanka.

Bhanuka Rajapaksa is down for a chat. He says that their team has done well so far and they will hope to do the same today. Mentions that their openers have done well, which has helped the rest of the batting unit. Adds that their team's confidence is up and they need to start well and go past them. Finishes by saying that they need to cope with the pressure and they are looking forward to their fifth win.

Dasun Shanaka the captain of Sri Lanka says that would have bowled first as well, but they are happy about batting first as well. Adds that they have been playing some good cricket and they are looking to continue to do the same. Mentions that the openers and the spinners have done well, and these are a few positives from this cup and this is good for the T20 World Cup as well. Informs that they are playing with the same team.

Babar Azam the captain of Pakistan says they will bowl first. Adds that they are looking for a good one as the stakes are high and they will try to win it. Mentions that they are ready for the challenge. Finally says that Usman Qadir and Hasan have been left out of the team and Naseem Shah and Shadab Khan are in.

Sri Lanka (Unchanged Playing XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Kusal Mendis (WK), Danushka Gunathilaka, Dhananjaya de Silva, Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Maheesh Theekshana, Dilshan Madushanka, Pramod Madushan.

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Fakhar Zaman, Iftikhar Ahmed, Khushdil Shah, Mohammad Nawaz, Asif Ali, Shadab Khan (In for Usman Qadir), Haris Rauf, Mohammad Hasnain, Naseem Shah (In for Hasan Ali).
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favor of Babar Azam. Pakistan have elected to BOWL first!

Pakistan on the other hand have done admirably well to reach the final of the Asia Cup. Their young pace attack has done a fine job for them while few of their batters are looking in good touch. Having played their previous game against Sri Lanka, Pakistan would know the area they would want to improve upon. It will be their batting unit that will have to come out with a stern plan to tackle Sri Lanka’s spin attack. Babar Azam has not had the best time in this competition and he will be hoping he gets back to form in this grand finale. Pakistan will be looking forward to adding their third Asia Cup trophy to their cabinet. Will they do so? We will know soon. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
